mentions.name: ApprovIQ
mentions.description: A document management and communications portal for construction certifiers, streamlining the back-and-forth approval of dozens of project documents that must be checked for compliance with requirements like drainage, water quality, and fire safety. It includes AI-powered document understanding to assist with reviewing compliance across documents.
mentions.problem: Construction certification is intensely technical and detail-oriented but is still mostly done by hand over email, with dozens of documents each requiring manual compliance checks.
mentions.audience: Construction certifiers who manage project approval workflows, wrangling large numbers of documents over email
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on ApprovIQ, a tool for construction certifiers.

evidence.value: I’m working on ApprovIQ, a tool for construction certifiers.

mentions.name: Approviq
mentions.description: This app helps people perform construction approvals, streamlining a process that previously involved dozens of documents and versions sent back and forth over email. It uses AI to provide verdicts that help humans make decisions on the many fiddly details that must be checked.
mentions.problem: Construction approvals involve dozens of documents and versions exchanged over email, with many fiddly details that must be manually checked.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The software itself helps people perform construction approvals.

Old way: dozens of documents and versions sent back and forth over email. Many fiddly details that must be checked - to streamline the process we'll use AI to provide verdicts that help humans make decisions.
